### A Picture of Prevailing Prayer
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-picture-of-prevailing-prayer
Passage: Mark 10:46-52
Points:
- Genuine prayer is rooted in deep spiritual need and holy desperation.
- Believers must not let initial delays or social pressure silence their cries to Jesus.
- God welcomes bold, persistent requests over polite passivity or fatalism.
- Jesus invites us to state clearly and specifically what we need from Him.
- Receiving Christ's transforming mercy moves a believer to follow Him on the road.

### How to Have Powerful Faith like Bartimaeus in the Bible
Author: Pamela Palmer
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/how-to-have-a-powerful-faith-like-bartimaeus.html
Passage: Mark 10:46-52
Points:
- Jesus stops to notice and serve individuals whom society often overlooks.
- True faith motivates believers to seek the Lord relentlessly despite discouraging voices.
- Jesus invites believers to bring their specific needs directly to Him in faith.
- Experiencing Christ's healing power leads to a daily life of following Him.
